text_block_list.text:
Cheers erupted from the stands for Agnes 
Tachyon's victory and her run.

Agnes Tachyon realizes the crowd's cheers 
enabled her to perform beyond her usual 
limits. She feels exhilarated by the 
unexpected result.

Her remaining target races this year were 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) and the Arima 
Kinen. She was steadily approaching what 
lay "beyond the limit."
